scope: Local implementation of reviewed application destinations and official blank-form evidence

migration.applied_to: isolated disposable PostgreSQL test database only

architecture: Authenticated routes for request and response handling
Service rules and typed validation/conflict errors
Separate worker discovery, bounded external fetch and persistence
Shared URL, program fingerprint and evidence contracts
limits: Application destinations require explicit administrator review, default 24 hours and at most 7 days; HTTP 200 does not renew that review.
Only approved public source scopes are fetched; credentials, cookies, authentication bypass and form submission are not used.
PDF and HWP headers/names are checked and metadata is hashed; downloaded bodies are discarded. This is not malware scanning or semantic form validation.
HWPX and DOCX are discovered as candidates only and are not verified or published as approved templates.
Tests do not establish that all existing production links or institution forms work.
Official file autofill, signing and submission are outside this implementation.
